dialogue.lewandivka.base_wake.2: It smells of tea and something pink.
dialogue.lewandivka.base_wake.3: Two empty places by the wall.
dialogue.lewandivka.cats_doors.1: Both of them look at the doors.
dialogue.lewandivka.chinazik_first.1: A black cat stares at you.
dialogue.lewandivka.chinazik_first.2: Then he walks the other way.
dialogue.lewandivka.debtor_found.1: Do not hit me! I can explain!
dialogue.lewandivka.debtor_found.2: I owe the tram. Three emeralds.
dialogue.lewandivka.debtor_found.3: Or... maybe we can agree on something?
dialogue.lewandivka.debtor_resolved_vouc: You are local. I will remember.
dialogue.lewandivka.greet_vendor_baker_2: Bread is the foundation of the district.
dialogue.lewandivka.greet_vendor_baker_3: Take a pie. I will not offer twice.
dialogue.lewandivka.greet_vendor_butcher: The pork is from yesterday. That is a compliment.
dialogue.lewandivka.greet_vendor_fishmon: The fish is fresh. I have not seen it myself.
Biting? Not biting? Take it cooked.
The river is big. The patience is bigger.
All used. Only the dust is new.
Tokens? No. Only the tram takes tokens.
dialogue.lewandivka.greet_vendor_gardene: Seeds are the future. A cheap one.
Plant it and it grows. Sometimes.
Bone meal is for the impatient.
dialogue.lewandivka.greet_vendor_greengr: The potatoes are mine. Not yours.
The apples are sour. But honest.
dialogue.lewandivka.greet_vendor_handyma: A tool is like a friend. Treat it well.
dialogue.lewandivka.head_lore.6: The cats remembered the old routes.
dialogue.lewandivka.post_cats12.1: Twelve more cats are around the district.
dialogue.lewandivka.post_garage0.2: It was not even in the notes.
dialogue.lewandivka.post_package.1: Do you want to know what was in the package?
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_chroma.3: The district used to be bigger.
Punches tickets. And not only those.
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_idle_2.1: Nothing is happening. That is good.
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_idle_3.1: A district is not a place. It is a habit.
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_idle_4.1: Do not stand under the boom.
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_kettle.3: A garage. The thirteenth. It does not exist.
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_kettle.4: So go and look for it.
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_kiosk.2: Haven't stood here in a while.
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_kiosk.3: There is a matter. A small one.
dialogue.lewandivka.shlahbaum_kiosk.4: Take this. It is all written there.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_babushk: The bread at the market is still warm.
A tram used to run here.
Do not go to the garages in the evening.
Feeding the cats? Good for you.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_grandpa: The barrier is up. A good day.
Do not put a nail on the rails.
Chess is for those who do not believe in fate.
The weather is not what it was.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_kid_2.2: No, I will not show you.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_kid_4.1: I saw a tram at night.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_kid_4.2: The adults say I dreamed it.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_kid_5.1: Mom said not to talk to strangers.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_kid_5.2: But you are almost one of us.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_neighbo: Got salt? No? I did not ask.
I have been here since ninety-one.
The bulb on the stairs is still not replaced.
Hear that ringing? It is not my phone.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_student: I have exams. Do not disturb.
Does the district not feel like a quest to you?
No cafes. But there is a market.
I take a pie and go study.
The signal only works on the roof here.
So everybody sits on the roof.
I saw a cat near the sandbox.
A black one. He looked judgmental.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_teacher: Tomorrow too. And the day after.
Children! No running in the corridor!
Oh, that was not for you.
Want to study? All the desks are free.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_worker_: Do not look like that. I quit. Long ago.
The lights flicker at the substations.
Someone in the garages is stealing current.
Go to the handyman at the market.
The thirteenth garage? There is no such thing.
There is a twelfth and a fourteenth.
dialogue.lewandivka.talk_citizen_yard_ke: This is my territory. Well, ours.
Sometimes there is something useful in the bins.
The lamps are burning. The district lives.
dialogue.lewandivka.tram_shield.1: I have a pass. A lifetime one.
dialogue.lewandivka.tram_start.1: Somewhere far away a tram bell rings.

item.lewandivka.water_core.lore: Carry with care. Wet from the inside.

note.lewandivka.0: No tram has run to the terminus since 1994. The stop still works.
note.lewandivka.1: Notice: the tea package on the bench is not mine. Do not touch.
note.lewandivka.10: The breakers are in nine. The third one goes first.
note.lewandivka.11: The first goes after the third and before the fourth.
note.lewandivka.12: The fourth is second to last. It is written down.
note.lewandivka.13: The second is always last. Do not ask why.
note.lewandivka.14: The box in three and the box in twenty-two. Press them together.
note.lewandivka.15: Can't manage with three? Two can. One can too, slowly.
note.lewandivka.16: As on the poster: up, down, up.
note.lewandivka.17: The lever opens the tunnel. Not for long.
note.lewandivka.30: PAINT WORKSHOP. Mix the way you were taught as a child.
note.lewandivka.31: Red and yellow make orange. Yellow and blue make green. Blue and red make purple.
note.lewandivka.32: LIFT HALL. The platforms rise in turn. Stand on them.
note.lewandivka.40: SHELTER. Names are not needed here.
note.lewandivka.42: The cat goes where nobody asks.
note.lewandivka.43: A box that is quiet is not the one.
note.lewandivka.44: The purring grows louder near the right one.
note.lewandivka.45: Scratches on cardboard are a signature.
note.lewandivka.46: The smaller box is the important one.
note.lewandivka.5: GARAGE COOPERATIVE. No entry for strangers. Not recommended for locals either.
note.lewandivka.50: DRY LAKE. The pools are temporarily closed.
note.lewandivka.52: Pump room: three starters. Begin with the outermost.
note.lewandivka.53: Red is a cross. Blue is a circle. Yellow is a triangle. Green is a square.
note.lewandivka.54: The water is orange. It is supposed to be.
note.lewandivka.60: The spring throws you up and a little forward. Mind your shoes.
note.lewandivka.61: Sky stop. The tram runs on a timetable nobody has seen.
note.lewandivka.63: The first and the third switch are "B".
note.lewandivka.64: The second and the fourth are "A". Whoever mixed them up rolls back. That is normal.
note.lewandivka.65: Tickets: cross, circle, triangle, square. The composter is mandatory.
note.lewandivka.7: Between twelve and fourteen there are bricks. There always were.
note.lewandivka.70: TOWER APPROACH. The dash is not an exit but a method.
note.lewandivka.73: DOOR 3. Opens only at speed. The last one.
note.lewandivka.74: This is not a wall. It was decided so.
note.lewandivka.75: Glider: press jump in the air.
note.lewandivka.8: The arrow points to thirteen. Do not trust the arrow.
note.lewandivka.80: Welcome to the Head of District. Estimated waiting time: undefined.
note.lewandivka.82: Urgent matters need no queue. This is not a joke.
note.lewandivka.83: ARCHIVE. Three reading levers. Raise them all while you remember.
note.lewandivka.85: The office that does not exist has a single lever.
note.lewandivka.86: DEPARTMENT OF COLOR VIOLATIONS. Mixing without a permit is forbidden.
note.lewandivka.87: Service shaft. Do not jump without springs.
note.lewandivka.88: The floor has collapsed. Repairs were scheduled for last Tuesday.
note.lewandivka.89: GARAGE No. 0. Those who did not get a number parked here.
note.lewandivka.9: Three panels turn the light on. All three are not where one looks.
note.lewandivka.90: The exit is the ladder. It was always there; nobody asked.
